comments.text: Correct: strings.EqualFold on the first 7 bytes makes the scheme match case-insensitive (per RFC 9110), and slicing is safe thanks to the length guard. Minor nit: a header that is exactly "Bearer " is returned unchanged rather than as an empty token, which is harmless since it fails token verification either way.
Trimming scenario header values mirrors how net/http parses incoming headers; fine. Make sure `strings` is imported in this file.
